required_manual_checks.description: production-2f-partner.test.ts (2026-08-29) asserts the sales principal is DENIED finance:*, documents:*, time:*, audits:*, portal:admin, production:toggle, import:run, promote, prospects:identity, clients:* and sops:read. Since 2G.4.7 and 2A.1c (owner decisions), core/auth/capabilities.ts grants sales all of them: sales is owner minus exactly admin:* and prospects:manage. The file has no enclosing transaction, so an unmodified run commits the user, membership and credential and then fails. Replace only the hand-typed held/denied lists with sets derived from capabilitiesForRole('owner') and capabilitiesForRole('sales'), asserting the withheld set is exactly [admin:*, prospects:manage] and checking can() on the resolved principal for every held and every withheld entry.

Add a first, write-free test inside the provisioning describe that asserts the capability boundary (withheld exactly admin:* and prospects:manage, nothing else) before the organization lookup and before any INSERT, so a wrong expectation stops the run with zero production writes. Test order is sequential in the file; the static test proves the ordering.

Every other statement of the one-shot is byte-identical: the gating variables, connectionConfigFor(..., 'migration'), the organization lookup (never created), the idempotent users/memberships INSERTs, setUserCredential and verifyPassword checks, resolvePrincipal checks, the ascend_sales password_hash denial, the disabled_at revocation proof and undo, and the guard describe. STAGE2G section 29 Ruling 5 (provisioning half unchanged, split must not weaken either half) is honored: only a stale expectation is corrected, and it is strictly stronger (it now also proves prospects:manage is withheld). A diff review must show no other hunk.

tests/architecture/partner-oneshot.test.ts, no database: the one-shot contains no hand-typed capability list; the boundary check is the first it() in the provisioning describe and precedes every INSERT/UPDATE; mutants (adding a withheld capability to sales, or removing a held one, applied to a copy of the table in memory) are detected by the same derivation. Classify it PROVEN static in gate-2g1.ts. production-2f-partner stays PARKED with its ASCEND_PROVISION_PARTNER_URL requirement.
Diff limited to the write paths. No production contact, no credential read, no provisioning run. Execution remains PARTNER-PROVISION-001, which takes this task as a prerequisite.

title: PARTNER-GATE-FIX-001 Bring the Stage 2F partner one-shot's capability expectations to the recorded authority model, checked before any write (no production contact)
